questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Argentina?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Argentina article.

questions.proof: In eastern Argentina is Buenos Aires, the capital of Argentina, it is also one of the largest cities in the world.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Argentina on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Argentina on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Argentina about 2,780,085 square kilometres; Panama about 74,177 square kilometres; Saint Lucia about 617 square kilometres; Monaco about 2 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Buenos Aires?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Argentina is Buenos Aires.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Argentina?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Argentina on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Argentina article.

questions.proof: It is bordered by Paraguay and Bolivia in the north, Brazil and Uruguay in the northeast, and Chile in the west and south.
